125:class Bsp(Layout):
126:    """This layout is inspired by bspwm, but it does not try to copy its
127:    features.
128:
129:    The first client occupies the entire screen space.  When a new client
130:    is created, the selected space is partitioned in 2 and the new client
131:    occupies one of those subspaces, leaving the old client with the other.
132:
133:    The partition can be either horizontal or vertical according to the
134:    dimensions of the current space: if its width/height ratio is above
135:    a pre-configured value, the subspaces are created side-by-side,
136:    otherwise, they are created on top of each other.  The partition
137:    direction can be freely toggled.  All subspaces can be resized and
138:    clients can be shuffled around.
139:
140:    All clients are organized at the leaves of a full binary tree.
141:
142:    An example key configuration is::
143:
144:        Key([mod], "j", lazy.layout.down()),
145:        Key([mod], "k", lazy.layout.up()),
146:        Key([mod], "h", lazy.layout.left()),
147:        Key([mod], "l", lazy.layout.right()),
148:        Key([mod, "shift"], "j", lazy.layout.shuffle_down()),
149:        Key([mod, "shift"], "k", lazy.layout.shuffle_up()),
150:        Key([mod, "shift"], "h", lazy.layout.shuffle_left()),
151:        Key([mod, "shift"], "l", lazy.layout.shuffle_right()),
152:        Key([mod, "mod1"], "j", lazy.layout.flip_down()),
153:        Key([mod, "mod1"], "k", lazy.layout.flip_up()),
154:        Key([mod, "mod1"], "h", lazy.layout.flip_left()),
155:        Key([mod, "mod1"], "l", lazy.layout.flip_right()),
156:        Key([mod, "control"], "j", lazy.layout.grow_down()),
157:        Key([mod, "control"], "k", lazy.layout.grow_up()),
158:        Key([mod, "control"], "h", lazy.layout.grow_left()),
159:        Key([mod, "control"], "l", lazy.layout.grow_right()),
160:        Key([mod, "shift"], "n", lazy.layout.normalize()),
161:        Key([mod], "Return", lazy.layout.toggle_split()),
162:    """

164:    defaults = [
165:        ("border_focus", "#881111", "Border colour(s) for the focused window."),
166:        ("border_normal", "#220000", "Border colour(s) for un-focused windows."),

175:        ("ratio", 1.6, "Width/height ratio that defines the partition direction."),
176:        ("grow_amount", 10, "Amount by which to grow a window/column."),
177:        ("lower_right", True, "New client occupies lower or right subspace."),
178:        ("fair", True, "New clients are inserted in the shortest branch."),
